requirement: v3.7.5 portability fixes: (1) scripts/p2p-handshake-check.mjs resolves its default device.json from the shared state-dir resolver instead of a hardcoded Windows user path; (2) findHarnessInstallation accepts the macOS .app bundle layout (<root>/Resources/app.asar + <root>/MacOS/DeepSeek Harness) so restore no longer refuses with BACKUP_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE on a machine where the Harness is installed at /Applications; (3) the six-row surface probe retries once with a 2000 ms budget before it publishes fallback:true.
notes: Findings come from the v3.7.3 five-machine run: the handshake script failed with ENOENT on macOS because its --device default named one Windows profile; restore refused on macOS with BACKUP_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE while /Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app was installed; and one IM2A loader run failed on assert.equal(diag.fallback, false) after all six 800 ms probes timed out on a cold start. The macOS bundle layout is covered here by a fake install tree under a temporary HOME plus platform:'darwin' (the real Mac check is the v3.7.5 five-machine rerun); the Windows layout and the null case are asserted in the same suite. The probe retry is guarded at source level because lib/client.js is a single browser-bundle factory that no test can import; its behaviour on a live page is covered by test/loader-entry.test.mjs --probes surfaces.
